name: Claude Code

tiers.name: Pro

limits.rollingCap: Shared 5-hour rolling session limit (>=5x Free tier)
limits.weeklyAllocation: Weekly caps on top of the 5-hour window
limits.overage: Opt-in usage credits billed at standard API rates, with optional monthly spend cap

estimatedTokenBudget.assumptions: Anthropic publishes no numeric quota; research estimate ~= 12M mid-complexity agent tokens/mo within the Pro 5h+weekly window; exact size intentionally unpublished and varies by task complexity

tiers.notes: Annual Pro is $17/mo ($200 billed up front). Claude Code shares one pool with Claude.ai chat

tiers.name: Max5x

limits.weeklyAllocation: Weekly sliding window scales with 5x multiplier
limits.overage: Usage credits at API rates (Fable draws weekly limits at 50%)

estimatedTokenBudget.assumptions: 5x the Pro research estimate; no official token figures published, low confidence

tiers.notes: Higher output limits and priority access at peak times

tiers.name: Max20x

limits.weeklyAllocation: Weekly sliding window scales with 20x multiplier

estimatedTokenBudget.assumptions: 20x the Pro research estimate; no official token figures published, low confidence

tiers.notes: Maximum plan for full-time agent workflows; billed monthly

gotchas: Usage is quota-based per rolling 5-hour session plus weekly caps, deliberately NOT token- or message-metered
After limits, work continues only if you opt into usage credits billed at standard API rates (with optional monthly spend cap)
Claude Code shares the same usage pool as Claude.ai chat, desktop and mobile
On Pro, Claude Fable 5.1 runs via usage credits only; on Max it consumes 50% of weekly limits
Cache TTL is 1 hour on subscriptions but drops to 5 minutes while drawing usage credits
dataTraining: Model training opt-out available on individual plans
